matchups.tips: | Ahri is a very squishy champion, with that said, she is not that hard to kill. Farm up to level 6 and go for an all-in. However do care, this is a skill match up. Ahri can easily predict your ultimate, with hers.

| She is pretty squishy, but do care for her damage late game. Her abilities is easy to dodge and if you ever have played Anivia before you know how her combos work. Care not to get trapped in her wall, and to not do stupid dive when she has passive up.

| If you by any chance would be against this champion it's pretty easy. Just dodge his Q and don't get trapped in his W a.k.a his balls (that sounded weird). Anyways when you stun him is W goes down for a moment, keep that in mind.
| Easy lane until level 6. Watch out for her all-ins. Try to Q her first when stunning her, she could easily dodge your R.
| Heavy poke, play passive. But you still want to trade so you don't get bullied to much. He is squishy, so an all-in would not be a bad idea. However ask for ganks in this lane.

| This match-up is in brand favor, he is a lane bully, has better range of his abilities than Annie. Do care since his all-ins are also really strong. Ask for ganks to get ahead, I would also suggest buying banshee's veil somewhere in the game.
| Just a monster, really snowbally. He also has a lot of damage, silence and knock-up. Just play passive and maybe rush merc threads so you resist some of his slow from his E and Q.

| Early game she is weak since her mana runs out quickly, and yours does not. Care when she comes back to lane with Tear of the goddess, she is just going to spam abilities and harass you since she also out ranges you.
| Hard to kill, can easily escape. He does a lot of damage early and late. Try to bully him pre-trinity force.
| Uncommon match-up, she is easy to bully, but DO WATCH OUT for her all-ins at level 6, they are really strong.
| Pretty easy lane, just harass him when he is coming for his minions. He does not have high kill threat, so just relax. When stunned he can not ult so try to burst him quickly.

| Depends if he is going AP or AD. AD is obviously going to be harder since he scales better with it. He is very squishy, but can escape easily as well. Just harass and bully him. Stay behind minions to not get hit by his Q, if he is going AP it won't really matter since he going to max his W which can't be blocked by minions.

| Very annoying champion, can easily dodge Q, W, R and anything you throw at him. If you are going to try to poke him, you need to know that his E is down. Fizz, as Katarina, also has a really good level 3. Watch out for his all-in level 6. CARE!
| Just try to farm in this lane, there is no idea trying to kill him, he is strong against mages and very tanky in general. Try to roam for kills.
| Just keep harassing him, stay back when your Q and W is on cooldown, that way he won't get a free Q. Try to get in easy auto attacks on him since he is melee. AA his barrels of course.
| A good Gragas can outplay you hard, but he is melee so just harass the hell out of him early and mid game.
| He has very good sustain. He is also very squish. Be careful to not get caught around his turrets, they can do much unexpected damage.
| Good harass, very squishy. Watch out for his jukes. He can do much unexpected damage and stuns in a short period of time.
| Watch out for her W, Q combo. Also she will probably try to ult Q you level 1 so just keep behind minions. When trying to all in just keep in mind that she has a big ass shield to help her.

| He can be harassed a lot pre-6, be careful of his power spike at level 6. He has his Q that gives him a magic shield, so i suggest that you don't try to Q him back, just wait for the shield to go down and do the usual Q, W, AA combo and trigger electrocute. Build MR!

| Skilled match-up, she has really good engage level 3 even when her E recently got nerfed. Don't play to aggressive, you could easily get punished. If she ever R's try to stun her with your R or W. They have low cast time.
| Very squishy, use Q to guarantee stun, then follow up with R and W.
| Try to stun her with Q so she can't W away, then follow up with R and W. She has strong level 3, but she easy to trade with. Make your team aware when she is gone since she has really strong roams.
| So, so squishy. Poor lux. However don't get caught by her Q. If you do get caught late game you are basically dead if you don't get Zhonyas. Just harass her early

| Mostly annoying. Can harass you very hard. He can zone the lane very good and has great sustain. You can't roam since you will lose a lot of farm. He does however have mana problems through out the game! I suggest taking TP in this lane.
| She has good damage and has good sustain. When her Black shield (E) is on cooldown try to burst her with your Q, W, AA combo to trigger electrocute.
| Very annoying lane. Just play passive and dodge her balls. She is squishy so try to wait for mid game when your team is starting to group. Try to burst her down since she has no HP.

| Hard, she out ranges you, has a far stun, and can burst you. Take barrier to maybe survive her ult damage, Zhonyas could also be a good alternative. I recommend Banshee's Veil and other MR items. Call for ganks since she has bad escape. If you would like to try to all-in her wait for her E so she can't stun you and turn the tables and just Q, R you.
| This is a joke lane, you can almost burst him down level 3. At level 6 you just demolish him. Make your team aware when he is level 6 however so they won't get ganked.

| If he ever dares to go up to you, just poke the hell out of him, he can't really do anything in this lane since his Q does nothing against you. Stay where your minions have been so you don't get hit by mushrooms. Get oracle also so you can use it without getting exploded by mushrooms when trying to escape or something.
| Same as Zed, try to rush Zhonyas to ignore his R, his early levels are strong when he is running ignite + electrocute. Be good at warding and SS'ing so your team does not get ganked.
| She has good sustain and control over the whole map due to her R. She his easy to harass and her skill shots are easy to dodge. You can burst her, but she can't.

| Can be annoying, but he will probably build toward spirit visage for the heal, so better build Liandry's Torment or Void staff. He will be op late game, so try to bully him in lane. Keep in mind that he as excellent sustain though.
| His passive deals true damage and can easily delete you, build tanky items like Protobelt, Liandry's Torment and such. He has far more range than you. Doding his Q and E is mediocrely easy however.

| Viktor is a hard bully champion, he has a very high skill-cap so it depends which Viktor you are playing against. But his kit has pretty much anything. However he is squishy so try to harass him early levels.

| Super easy, he does zero damage early game so try to harass and poke him as much as possible. He is very squishy so just delete him late game, when is at his most powerful stage. If you can deny farm and keep him away from lane, he won't even be able to come to that late game power spike.

| Xerath has very good poke, and he does not easily run out of mana, because of his passive. He will probably try to slow you with his W which is very hard to dodge then try to Q you. Since Annie does not have much mobility you will be bullied hard.
| Not hard, just AA him on his shield like you would with any other champion. Try to bait is windwall with AA's. Stun him with your W instead of Q since it can go through the windwall.

| Not hard, but not easy. He does a lot of damage, I would recommend to get Zhonyas and ignore his ult. Other then that just try to Q stun him instead of ulting first since he could potentially dodge your R.

| Very high damage, a good Ziggs can easily kill you with one combo. He is super squishy however, take that weakness to your advantage. His whole kit surrounds long range abilities, so he has an advantage in range.

| Still a new champion, but try to dodge her E (sleep), keep things warded since her E goes further when she is behind walls. Be really aware of the mini map and SS when she is gone, so the other lanes won't get killed by her long range sleep. Keep in mind that her ult is really predictable and she will come back to the area she first ulted on.
| Same as Ekko, he can't ult when he is stunned, he is also very squishy so try to burst him before he can use his R. Other than that just dodge his time bombs and you will be fine.
| Pretty easy, just harass and poke. It is pretty straight forward, just be cautious of the enemy jungler so she does not get ahead.
| Just try to farm this lane, you can not do much without your jungler to follow up when she e's away.
| You trade pretty even, but you definitely have the advantage. You have better burst and trade. Make sure you dodge her root and you will be fine.
| Low hp, just burst him to death. You have to have some faker game juice ready so you can dodge like a pro. Go perfect timing so he can not get a free kill when you kill him at level 6/7
| Pretty boring lane just try your best. Important to dodge his claw. Otherwise just harass him since he has a short range. You do have more burst dmg than him which can favor you a lot.

Akshan is very annoying to deal with. Make sure to stand away from the minion wave so his Q does not hit you with its extension and ping when he roams. Also save your stun for when he E's since he will be very vulnerable.
